rm(list = ls())
cat("\014")

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)
library(readxl)

# ===============================
# 1. CARGA DE DATOS NEXI CC
# ===============================
# Selecciona tu archivo "all_NEXI_CC_bueno.xlsx"
MD_OUT <- read_excel(file.choose())
MD_limpio <- MD_OUT

# ===============================
# 2. FORMATEO VARIABLES Y FUSIÓN DE HEMISFERIOS
# ===============================
MD_limpio$MouseID <- as.factor(MD_limpio$MouseID)

MD_limpio$Sex <- factor(MD_limpio$Sex,
                        levels = c(1,2),
                        labels = c("Male","Female"))

MD_limpio$Diet <- factor(MD_limpio$Diet,
                         levels = c(1,2),
                         labels = c("LFLS","HFHS"))

# NUEVO MAPEO: Ajustado estrictamente a tus 3 IDs del nuevo script de MATLAB
# Los IDs 1 y 2 (hip2_left e hip2_right) se fusionan al llamarse igual: "hip2"
MD_limpio$ROI <- factor(MD_limpio$ROI,
                        levels = c(1, 2, 3),
                        labels = c("hip2", "hip2", "CC"))

# ===============================
# 3. PROMEDIOS POR RATÓN Y ÁREA FUSIONADA
# ===============================
MD_promedios <- MD_limpio %>%
  group_by(MouseID, Sex, Diet, ROI) %>%
  summarise(
    across(c(di, de, f, t_ex), \(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Condicion = factor(paste(ifelse(Sex == "Female", "fem", "male"), Diet))
  )

# ===============================
# 4. ESTÉTICA
# ===============================
parametros <- c("di", "de", "f", "t_ex")

colores_condicion <- c(
  "fem HFHS"  = "green4",
  "male HFHS" = "blue3",
  "fem LFLS"  = "plum2",
  "male LFLS" = "red3"
)

# ===============================
# 5. GENERACIÓN DEL PDF (Fijo en tu nueva carpeta de resultados)
# ===============================
ruta_pdf <- "C:/Users/lolan/Downloads/Diffusion_times/Resultados_NEXI_CC/graficas_NEXI_CC_TFG.pdf"
pdf(ruta_pdf, width = 12, height = 6) # Ajustamos el tamaño horizontal para el formato 1x2

for(param in parametros){
  
  areas_presentes <- levels(droplevels(MD_promedios$ROI))
  lista_plots <- list()
  
  for(area_sel in areas_presentes){
    
    datos_area <- MD_promedios %>% filter(ROI == area_sel)
    
    p <- ggplot(datos_area,
                aes(x = Condicion,
                    y = .data[[param]],
                    fill = Condicion)) +
      
      geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.5) +
      geom_jitter(width = 0.12, size = 3.5, aes(color = Condicion)) +
      
      scale_fill_manual(values = colores_condicion) +
      scale_color_manual(values = colores_condicion) +
      
      labs(title = paste("Área:", toupper(area_sel)),
           x = "Grupo / Condición",
           y = param) +
      
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        legend.position = "none",
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 15, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 10),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
      )
    
    lista_plots[[area_sel]] <- p
  }
  
  # ===============================
  # PAGINACIÓN (Fila de 1x2: Hip2 a la izquierda y CC a la derecha)
  # ===============================
  grid.arrange(
    grobs = lista_plots,
    ncol = 2,  # 2 columnas sueltas
    nrow = 1,  # 1 sola fila
    top = grid::textGrob(
      paste("Métrica NEXI:", toupper(param)),
      gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 16, font = 2)
    )
  )
}

dev.off()
cat(paste('\n¡PDF generado con éxito en:', ruta_pdf, '!\n'));
